overview: The School Committee addressed student recognitions, field trip approvals, and school fundraising oversight. Members also referred proposed updates to the medication administration policy back to subcommittee and passed a resolution urging the state legislature to reform the foundation budget formula.

items.title: Approval of Bills, Transfer of Funds, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the routine bills, fund transfers, and payrolls following member questions regarding specific expenditures.

items.title: Report of Secretary
items.summary: Placed on file a revised secretary's report recognizing city and school finance personnel.

items.title: Medication Administration Policy
items.summary: Referred the proposed policy back to the Support Services Subcommittee after discussions regarding parental consent requirements when school nurses consult physicians to adjust student medication orders.

items.title: Report on Project 351
items.summary: Received presentations from eighth-grade ambassadors Margaret Hines and Vishal Romero regarding their participation in Project 351's statewide day of service.

items.title: Report on Judge Sandra L. Klein Visit
items.summary: Heard a report and student remarks detailing a school visit by U.S. Bankruptcy Judge Sandra L. Klein, an alumna of Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Recognition of School Volunteers
items.summary: Recognized volunteers from Big Brothers Big Sisters of Greater Boston, Tufts University, and the Mystic Valley Elder Services reading partner program.

items.title: Superintendent's Update and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on Priscilla's Pantry, student athletics and music accomplishments, the Ethics Bowl victory, recent math learning walks, and upcoming district events.

items.title: Approval of Field Trips
items.summary: Approved the annual eighth-grade trip to New York City and the McGlynn Middle School seventh-grade environmental education trip to the University of Rhode Island's Alton Jones campus.

items.title: Approval of Donations
items.summary: Accepted a donation of computer headphones for Roberts Elementary School and an estimated $13,000 to $15,000 donation from Impact Church to replace auditorium lighting at the McGlynn School.

items.title: Report on Fundraising Organizations
items.summary: Discussed the tracking and reporting requirements for affiliated 501(c)(3) organizations and requested a follow-up list of internal student activity accounts.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Adopted condolence resolutions for several community members, including former School Committee member William Brady.

items.title: Resolution on Foundation Budget Formula and the Education Promise Act
items.summary: Adopted a resolution urging the Massachusetts legislature to fully fund a reformed foundation budget formula and support the Education Promise Act.
